cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/lhrun2/runs/hacker/samples/72a2190dc19b8309/a1/work/ws && python3 -c "
import parse

print('=== R1: letters format specifier ===')
p = parse.Parser('{name:l}')
r = p.parse('hello')
assert r is not None, 'Basic letters match failed'
assert r['name'] == 'hello'
print('  Basic match: OK')

r2 = p.parse('12345')
assert r2 is None, 'Digits should not match letters spec'
print('  Digits rejected: OK')

p2 = parse.Parser('{name:l} {num:d}')
r3 = p2.parse('hello 123')
assert r3 is not None
assert r3['name'] == 'hello'
assert r3['num'] == 123
print('  Combined fields: OK')

try:
    parse.Parser('{n:l} {n:w}')
    assert False, 'Should have raised RepeatedNameError'
except parse.RepeatedNameError:
    print('  RepeatedNameError raised: OK')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'  Wrong exception: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# {n:w} {n:w} same type - should work normally
p4 = parse.Parser('{n:w} {n:w}')
r4 = p4.parse('hello world')
print('  {n:w} {n:w} parse result:', r4)
if r4:
    print('  n:', r4['n'])
print()

print('=== R2: __contains__ operator ===')
p6 = parse.Parser('{name} {}')
r = p6.parse('hello world')
assert 'name' in r
assert 0 in r
print('  named key and int index: OK')

s = parse.search('{name}', 'hello world')
assert 'name' in s, 'named key in search result'
print('  Search contains: OK')

for r in parse.findall('{name}', 'hello world'):
    assert 'name' in r
    print('  Findall contains: OK')
    break

r8 = parse.parse('{}', 'hello')
assert r8[0] == 'hello'
assert 'hello' in r8, f'value hello in fixed: got False'
print('  Value in fixed tuple: OK')

# str key that is also a value
r9 = parse.parse('{name}', 'hello')
assert 'name' in r9, 'named key'
print('  Named key string: OK')
print()

print('=== R3: Brace validation ===')
valid_patterns = ['{name}', '{{hello}}', 'prefix {x} suffix', '{x} {y}', 'hello', '{x:l}']
for fmt in valid_patterns:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        print(f'  Valid: {fmt!r} -> OK')
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f'  Valid: {fmt!r} -> UNEXPECTED ERROR: {e}')

invalid_patterns = ['{x', 'x}', '{x} {y', '{{x}']
for fmt in invalid_patterns:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        print(f'  Invalid: {fmt!r} -> UNEXPECTEDLY ACCEPTED')
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f'  Invalid: {fmt!r} -> correctly rejected: {e}')
print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
